key_highlights: ASX slumps sharply as miners and banks fall amid oil price spike and rate hike fears; 10-year Treasury yield breaks out
Australia's economy grew 2.1% in year to June, narrowly avoiding recession, but faster-than-expected growth raises RBA rate hike risk (4th hike looming)
Mortgage stress hits 18-year highs; house prices could fall 10% as rate pressure intensifies; Sydney developer Bathla warns it could fold by week's end
US-Iran strikes drive oil to two-month high, fuelling inflation fears and bond yield spike globally
Australia's productivity performance rated 'bad to worse'; inflation woes confirmed as home-grown
CSL signs deal with Trump administration to slash medicine prices, raising revenue concerns for CSL.AX
Coal sector booms; multiple gold and critical mineral discoveries in WA (Gateway, King River, McLaren, Larvotto)
Qantas ground crews vote for right to strike amid pay dispute; Jetstar launches first Western Sydney Airport flight
Global debt spiral alarm signals; world in elevated geopolitical risk environment

sectors.trend: Miners fall on ASX despite coal boom and multiple WA discoveries (Gateway gold near Wiluna, King River 44g/t jags, McLaren titanium surge, Larvotto antimony). Oil spike benefits energy miners but weighs on metals via rate-hike-driven AUD strength and demand fears.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from rate fears; coal names (WDS.AX, BOQ.AX) supported by price boom. Gold miners (GWN.AX, NGM.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows amid US-Iran tension. Critical minerals (antimony, tungsten, titanium) attract strategic interest.

sectors.trend: Banks fall on ASX as rate hike fears hit equity valuations; mortgage stress at 18-year highs raises NIM compression and credit loss concerns. CBA.AX faces reputational hit from 13-year inactive card fee scandal. Star Group (SGH.AX) leadership turmoil.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cycle peak and housing stress. Credit losses may rise if house prices fall 10%. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) highly vulnerable to rate hikes.

sectors.trend: Oil hits two-month high on US-Iran strikes; coal booms domestically. Energy sector is the clear relative outperformer.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BOQ.AX, WEL.AX benefit from oil/coal price strength. However, higher energy costs feed into inflation, complicating RBA path.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX signs deal with Trump administration to slash medicine prices, creating significant revenue headwind. Sector otherwise defensive.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces margin compression from US pricing pressure; offset by defensive demand. SSW.AX, OSH.AX relatively insulated.

sectors.trend: Qantas (QAN.AX) ground crews vote for strike right; Jetstar (JLH.AX) launches Western Sydney Airport. Denny's rival and kids clothing giant file for closures/bankruptcy globally.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational risk from industrial action. Consumer discretionary under pressure from mortgage stress and inflation. WES.AX, WDW.AX face softening demand.

sectors.trend: Housing market 'bloodbath' feared; 10% house price decline predicted; Bathla developer near collapse; 'Evergrande moment' for mega developer. Mortgage stress at 18-year high.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face severe rate and occupancy risk. Construction (WBC.AX, GPT.AX) exposed to developer defaults. Housing affordability crisis deepens.

key_themes: RBA 4th rate hike risk elevated by 2.1% GDP growth and home-grown inflation
US-Iran geopolitical shock driving oil spike and global risk-off
Australian housing market at inflection point: mortgage stress, developer defaults, potential 10% price correction
Productivity deterioration ('bad to worse') undermining long-term growth narrative
Coal and critical minerals boom offsetting metals weakness
Global debt spiral and rising bond yields pressuring equities
CSL US pricing deal as structural margin risk for healthcare

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA 4th rate hike and prolonged tight policy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and rate-sensitive exposure; favour fixed-income ladders; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Iran escalation and oil price spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; increase allocation to coal/LNG names; monitor AUD/USD for import-cost inflation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and developer defaults
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid high-leverage property developers; reduce REIT exposure; monitor NAB/CBA credit loss provisions
Favour productivity-enhancing sectors (tech, automation); avoid low-margin consumer staples
Reduce QAN.AX position; monitor JLH.AX as relative beneficiary

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global debt spiral and rising bond yields
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favour cash and short-bond allocations; monitor 10-year Treasury and Australian GBA yields

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight coal and energy names on oil/coal price strength
opportunities.rationale: Coal boom and oil spike from US-Iran tension provide near-term revenue tailwinds; WDS.AX and BOQ.AX benefit directly

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold miner exposure on safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: US-Iran tension and global debt spiral support gold; WA discoveries (Gateway, King River) add exploration upside
Larvotto antimony, Viking tungsten, McLaren titanium signal supply-side tightening; strategic demand from energy transition

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive healthcare via SSW.AX, OSH.AX (avoid CSL.AX short-term)
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX faces US pricing headwind from Trump deal; domestic healthcare names insulated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 18-year mortgage stress, 10% house price decline risk, developer defaults (Bathla, Evergrande analogue) create severe downside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank equities pending rate path clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate hike fears compress equity valuations; credit loss risk from housing stress; CBA.AX reputational hit

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising yields (10-year Treasury breakout) reward short-duration; global debt spiral warrants liquidity buffer

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce QAN.AX ahead of potential strike action
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground crew strike vote creates operational and revenue risk; JLH.AX may benefit from substitution

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. RBA 4th rate hike risk, oil-driven inflation, and housing stress dominate. Miners and banks lead declines; energy and gold are relative outperformers. Volatility elevated on US-Iran geopolitical risk. AUD likely firm on rate differential but vulnerable to oil import costs.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA peaks and housing stabilises. Productivity concerns and per-capita recession risk cap upside. Coal/energy transition and critical minerals offer structural themes. CSL US pricing deal is a multi-year margin overhang. Housing correction, if it materialises, will be a 12–18 month drag on financials and construction.
